methodology: Phase 1 - Acquisition & OCR: PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 text extraction with per-item confidence scoring; SHA-256 fingerprint recorded at intake and re-verified at read.

Phase 2 - Campaigns / Suspects / Timeline: clustering, anchor derivation and event reconstruction over the correlated evidence set.
